title: Preview contact form discards leads
evidence: Deployed bundle index-loEUXYym.js: submit handler is i.preventDefault(),r(!0); this changes the thank-you state without sending data.
fix: Deploy the newer form implementation, configure a real endpoint, and verify receipt in the actual monitored inbox/CRM. Confirm failure handling.
acceptance: A clearly marked authorized test request reaches the office with all fields; failed requests never claim receipt.

title: Preview differs from repository
evidence: Preview lacks the repository’s Seo component output, FAQ, labeled controls, and functional submission helper.
fix: Identify the hosting project/build source and deploy the audited commit plus launch fixes. Record the deployed commit.
acceptance: Production metadata and behavior match the intended build, including all deep routes.

title: Production domain not ready
evidence: HTTPS requests to apex and www failed TLS negotiation; HTTP apex returned 200 without HTTPS redirection during this audit.
fix: Attach both hostnames, provision valid TLS, choose apex HTTPS canonical, redirect HTTP and www. Recheck from a second network.
acceptance: All production routes load with valid HTTPS; alternate hosts redirect once to final URLs.

title: Domain migration not implemented/verified
evidence: Old links use /about-us/ and /contact-us/; new app uses /about and /contact. No migration rules in provided vercel.json.
fix: Implement page-to-page permanent redirects at old hosting/edge. Preserve old-domain registration, TLS and email DNS.
acceptance: Every mapped old URL reaches its relevant new destination; no redirect loops or mass homepage redirects.

title: Production URL values still point at staging
evidence: BUSINESS.siteUrl defaults to preview; local render confirms preview canonicals. robots.txt, sitemap.xml and raw index.html image URLs are separately hardcoded.
fix: Set VITE_SITE_URL=https://weathersair.com and rebuild; also update/generate static sitemap, robots and raw social URLs. README claim that sitemap automatically reads BUSINESS is inaccurate.
acceptance: No staging URLs in production canonicals, schema IDs, sitemap, robots sitemap reference or share images.

title: Preview SEO basics missing
evidence: Same generic title across marketing pages; description describes the website itself; rendered checks show no canonical/JSON-LD on Home, Services, Reviews and About. Preview sitemap returns 404.
fix: Deploy and verify route metadata/schema; publish valid XML sitemap and truthful social preview.
acceptance: Unique relevant page titles/descriptions; correct canonicals; parseable schema; sitemap 200 XML.

title: Shop widget covers mobile call action
evidence: At 390 × 844 the floating SHOP tab overlaps part of Call Now; widget target is old-domain /shop/#/.
fix: Disable sidebar widget outside Shop or position above the call bar with safe-area spacing. Update Contractor Commerce domain and outbound widget URL.
acceptance: Both call and schedule controls are fully visible/tappable at 320–430px, including with vendor script loaded.

title: Newsletter is nonfunctional/misleading
evidence: Preview Subscribe is a button without handler. Repository mailto fallback sets done and says “You’re on the list” before any subscription occurs.
fix: Remove newsletter for launch unless a real subscription service is configured; show success only after enrollment is confirmed.
acceptance: No false success and no silent dead-end control.

title: Form validation incomplete in repository
evidence: Contact uses noValidate but handler only checks phone length. Empty name, malformed email, or email preference without an email can proceed.
fix: Validate name, phone, optional email syntax, and email when selected; validate server-side, rate-limit and handle provider-specific response semantics.
acceptance: Invalid fields stop submission with associated errors; valid request reaches the office.

title: Privacy page is dropped
evidence: Old navigation includes /privacy-policy/; no equivalent route/footer link in new app. Forms and vendor scripts collect/process data.
fix: Publish an accurate privacy notice reflecting actual form, analytics and commerce vendors; map old policy URL to it.
acceptance: Accessible footer/form policy link with accurate data-handling information.

title: Single services URL limits intent coverage
evidence: Seven services are fragments of /services, with short commercial/plumbing/electrical sections. Fragments do not provide separate service landing pages.
fix: Build substantive AC repair, heating repair, installation, maintenance and commercial pages, followed by verified plumbing/electrical/duct services.
acceptance: Each distinct service has useful unique content, internal links, metadata and a clear conversion path.

title: History and service claims need reconciliation
evidence: 40 years/since the 1980s conflicts with 48+ years. Copy alternates after-hours and 24/7. Hero service card promises up to 35% efficiency gain; service text instead describes air loss.
fix: Confirm founding year and dispatch hours with owner; replace unsupported numbers and distinguish leakage from savings. Verify awards, credentials, customer counts and free-estimate terms.
acceptance: One verified factual record drives visible copy and schema.

title: Duct-cleaning claims overstate evidence
evidence: Service copy says dirty ducts are “most likely” behind comfort problems and suggests health/energy benefits broadly.
fix: Use inspection-led explanations with limits; avoid implying guaranteed health improvements or savings. EPA guidance is linked below.
acceptance: Claims supported by evidence; cleaning distinguished from sealing and full-system maintenance.

title: Missing pages return 200
evidence: Preview /audit-missing-page-20260930 returns 200; repository also rewrites every path to index.html.
fix: Serve real 404 status for unknown routes while retaining direct access to valid app routes. Client noindex is only a fallback.
acceptance: Unknown URL returns 404 with helpful navigation; valid deep links remain 200.

title: HTML depends on JavaScript
evidence: Raw index.html has an empty root; SEO component runs in useEffect. Google can render JS, but other crawlers and share previews may not.
fix: Prerender or server-render marketing routes and route metadata. Preserve interactive React behavior.
acceptance: curl/view-source contains meaningful page-specific copy, title, canonical and schema.

title: Social destinations need verification
evidence: Preview social icons use #. Repository Facebook/Yelp URLs differ from the existing site’s linked profiles.
fix: Verify owned profiles before publishing; use one sameAs/NAP source. Old Facebook is /Weathersheatingandcooling; old Yelp is /weathers-heating-and-cooling-columbus.
acceptance: Each icon reaches the correct business; accessible names describe destinations.

title: Shop loading and metadata need handling
evidence: Catalog initially blank, later loaded; vendor changes title to “Online Shop - Products” and uses hash routes.
fix: Provide visible loading/error/fallback states; verify final-domain authorization, product/cart flow and title behavior. Treat service SEO as separate from hash-based product SEO.
acceptance: No unexplained blank store; catalog, product and cart work on production; no accidental orders in testing.

title: Lead attribution unverified
evidence: No first-party GA4/GTM or lead-event implementation found in repository. Preview includes platform PostHog; that does not establish client conversion tracking.
fix: Configure owner-controlled analytics and measure successful leads, phone clicks and booked jobs.
acceptance: Debug/test events verified; no duplicate SPA page views or PII in analytics.

title: Dependency advisories
evidence: npm audit: 7 affected packages, 2 high and 5 moderate, including Vite and React Router.
fix: Review advisory applicability and upgrade safely; keep dev servers private. Do not treat build-tool advisories as proof of exploitable static production code.
acceptance: Updated lockfile and passing checks with applicability documented.
